free_tier_limits.correction: DeepL API Free (500k chars/month) and API Pro can no longer be purchased. Current free plan is DeepL API Developer: 1,000,000 characters total (not monthly; does not reset). Free keys still use https://api-free.deepl.com; paid use api.deepl.com. Paid plans are Growth (included chars + overage) and Enterprise.

cors.correction: no — DeepL API does not allow browser CORS; client-side requests fail with HTTP 403 “blocked by CORS policy”; use a backend or proxy
